settings.question: Do I need any experience?
settings.answer: No experience needed. Each class lists its level so you can pick the right one.

settings.question: What is your refund policy?
settings.answer: Full refund up to 7 days before the class. After that, you can transfer to another session once.

settings.question: How do I join an online class?
settings.answer: You'll receive the join link by email after checkout and again 24 hours before class.

settings.question: Can I buy a class as a gift?
settings.answer: Yes! Gift cards are available and can be used for any class.
